document.adaptation: Cue added (“Igor said”) to a quote the article attributes to Igor without saying so in this paragraph.
document.text: What is different however are the people. “I like it here. The simple human interaction — I get greeted every day on my way to work by the neighbors. There is sense of neighborhood. There is a lot of energy and I like that. Even our real estate agent, who speaks no English or Russian is helpful,” Igor said.
